## Resolved on installed candidate15 — 2026-10-06

Distribution `ed5a6a51f5974deec8748fbf0dbd2f4984b690f5`, ES `bab4df649f48847cc43d21c77c058107ad902754`. [Installed resolution](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/audits/2026_10_06-milestone-m7-p4-fixes-383/08-installed-resolution.md), [145 assertions and29 reviewed frames](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/p4-presentation-fixes-01), [direct frame review](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/presentation-primary-frame-review.json), and [original/fixed French-output control](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/presentation-language-control) are published on next `4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3`. Actual running ES exports the chosen locale; required phone controls and actual native finishing text render in EN/FR. The broad phone keyboard page remains English, outside this specified change.

The installed handler/window and real signed-in callback use an owned local provider Session stand-in. Keep retains the window; Close exits without creating a done marker. Actual finishing/done-marker frames persist at0,5,15seconds until explicit dismissal. Reconnect success/dismissal/empty profiles cover EN/FR640/1280; refusal/pending retention covers EN640. Allfour result channels0 and11 owner seals; actual guest/browser/WebDriver/server/tunnel cleanup was verified21:09:00UTC. #351's overbroad earlier bilingual tick is now corrected using these artifacts. No hosted credential claim, Dropbox requirement, or new RA reset.

Already written: no account, cache, save or cloud-path conversion is needed. The existing callback/done protocol and safe-first confirmation behavior are retained. Other #471 findings remain open.

## Historical audit finding

Found by the independent #383 audit, criterion I351-L62; related #351/#354.

D-CLOUD-164 includes the phone close confirmation and finishing page in its
approved strings and requires French alongside English. The installed source
still serves literal English: `cloud_oauth` lines1016/1179 and
`cloud-signin-window.c` lines430–450. Neither path reads the selected language
or passes these strings through a translation mechanism. The ES catalog cannot
translate HTML generated by these separate processes.

Exact replacement14 payload hashes match the reviewed implementation. Existing
installed English frames show the confirmation-page context and finishing
screen; a French-mode sign-in run has not yet been performed. This is a source
contract failure, with target-language runtime proof required for the repair.

Already written: no account, credential, cache, save or cloud-path format changes
are needed. Preserve the confirmation's safe answer first, send Escape only on
confirmed Close, and preserve the actual done-marker/window transition.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Use owned local sign-in fixtures and the actual
installed window in EN/FR; no authenticated Dropbox or physical device is needed.

- [x] The newly required phone confirmation and finishing text follow the selected
  system language; source and installed payload hashes identify the implementation.
- [x] Original English-only source fails a meaningful French-output control; fixed
  EN/FR controls pass without changing Keep/Close/Escape behavior.
- [x] Actual390px phone and640px installed finishing frames show complete readable
  EN/FR text. The finishing proof rejects the prior page and records the done-marker
  transition, matching existing sign-in custody and cleanup requirements.
- [x] Reconcile #351's bilingual criterion and audit finding using these artifacts;
  keep #463's optional authenticated provider observation separate.
